evidence_spans: Solving the system numerically with the fit values from the bilayers, assuming a generation rate equivalent to one sun and neglecting bulk recombination, we arrive at upper limits for interface-dominated recombination lifetimes: 200 ns (control) and 750 ns (OAI-treated).
